knowledge.time_trial_method: Fetch the current assigned ZIP after start, extract with infected, derive all 32 fields from its five members, match the current answer IDs, and submit in one process. Reuse Rust Belt parsing helpers; never carry instance values forward.
knowledge.mastery_method: Fetch both current assigned ZIPs, extract each with infected, derive the 32 fields per delivery from its own bytes, prefix set1. and set2., verify the current 64 answer IDs, and submit together. Use --retry only for an intentional new attempt.
